MAKE THE CONVERSATION USEFUL

Bring the details.
Ask the right questions.

  • Your services and the states where you work
  • Estimated annual revenue and crew size
  • The equipment you own, rent or transport
  • Any insurance requirements in your customer contracts

Topics to discuss with the provider

General liabilityWorkers’ compensationEquipment & tools

These are discussion topics, not a coverage recommendation. Ask a licensed insurance professional which policies fit your work.

MowMatter provides the resource link; Simply Business and participating insurers handle quotes, coverage advice, policies and claims. MowMatter does not sell or underwrite insurance. Coverage is subject to the policy’s terms, limits and exclusions.

CLEAR EXPECTATIONS

Your business. Your choice.

Do I need a MowMatter account to explore insurance?

No. The insurance link opens Simply Business’s website. You can review their information without creating a MowMatter account.

Is there a MowMatter discount?

No MowMatter discount or exclusive offer is currently available. Any future offer will state its eligibility, terms and provider.

Who helps me choose coverage?

A licensed insurance professional can answer questions about coverage and suitability. Review the actual policy with the provider before purchasing.

Will clicking the link share my MowMatter customer list?

No customer list or MowMatter account details are included in this link. Information you choose to submit on the provider’s website is governed by that provider’s privacy policy.
